type Lend struct
  ID string
  Engine string
  Store string
  Object string
  Name string
  Link string
  Kind Link
  Size int64
  Created string
type LendResult struct
  Outcome LendOutcome
  Lend *Lend
  Detail string
type UnlendResult struct
  Outcome UnlendOutcome
  Detail string
type LendPage struct
  Outcome LendsOutcome
  Lends []Lend
  Continuation string
  Complete bool
type EndpointRefusalDetail struct
  Source EndpointRefusalSource
  Decision EndpointRefusalDecision
  Ask EndpointRefusalAsk
  Action string
  Question string
  Credential string
  RetryAfterMs int64

  Kind string
  Copy string
  State EndpointProducerCheckState
  Reason string
  Checked string

  Guarantees []string
  Capabilities map[string]string
  DefinitionHash string

  Outcome EndpointDescriptionOutcome

  Services []EndpointServiceState
  Refusal *EndpointRefusalDetail
  Reason string
  Checks []EndpointProducerCheck

  Value EndpointDescription

type Lending interface
  Lend(store, object, engine string, copy_ bool) (LendResult, error)
  Unlend(entry string) (UnlendResult, error)
  Lends(continuation string, limit int64) (LendPage, error)
type LendingTransport interface
  FrameExchanger

  Handler Lending
